description: This shell script provides configurations and setup routines for 3G cellular interfaces, including initialization, setup, and teardown procedures. It manages different network services and interacts with the device via GCOM scripts.

methods.name: proto_3g_init_config
methods.description: Initializes configuration options for the 3G network protocol, defining parameters such as device, APN, service, pincode, delay, and dialnumber.

methods.name: proto_3g_setup
methods.description: Sets up the 3G connection by configuring the device, handling PIN and mode settings, and starting the PPP connection with specified options.

methods.name: proto_3g_teardown
methods.description: Terminates the 3G connection by killing the associated protocol process.
